en.title: Total Viewers of the Top Regions
en.description:
For each query k, find the total number of viewers in the k regions with the most viewers. Regions with equal viewer counts are counted separately; queries are independent and are answered in input order.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n q, the second line contains n viewer counts, and the third line contains q queries. Original bounds: 1≤n,q≤100000, 1≤viewers≤10^9, 1≤k≤n. This site outputs exact integers, not limited by the original int return signature.
en.output: Output q exact integers in query order, separated by whitespace.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 10 16 21; 14 7; 1 1. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort the viewer counts in descending order and build prefix sums; the k-th prefix sum is the answer to the query.
